title: Development of Photo-Polymerization-Type 3D Printer for High-Viscosity Ceramic Resin Using CNN-Based Surface Defect Detection
summary: CNN/DenseNet defect classifier integrated into a ceramic-resin photopolymerization printer; reported 98% image classification accuracy. Defect labels drove real-time feedback, and reblading improved pore/minor-defect surfaces in printed specimens. Bounded engineering system result.
ai_technology: §§3–4: trained DenseNet CNN classifies printer-camera surface images and informs quality/feedback decisions
organization: Seoul National University of Science and Technology

evidence.tested: CNN/DenseNet defect classifier integrated into a ceramic-resin photopolymerization printer; reported 98% image classification accuracy. Defect labels drove real-time feedback, and reblading improved pore/minor-defect surfaces in printed specimens. Bounded engineering system result.
